desc.coastalHazards: Coastal erosion, storm surge and sea-level rise along the coastal strip.
desc.drought: Agricultural and meteorological drought from 34 years of satellite rainfall (CHIRPS v3) and ERA5 temperature.
desc.earthquake: Maximum estimated shaking from the USGS catalogue of M4.5+ earthquakes since 1960 (East African Rift).
desc.environmentalDegradation: Deforestation and soil erosion that amplify other hazards.
desc.flood: Riverine and urban flooding: heavy-rain frequency and recorded floods, weighted by exposed population.
desc.heatwave: Heat exposure derived from ERA5 temperature climatology.
desc.landslide: Rainfall-triggered slope failure, mainly in the highlands.
desc.lightning: Lightning hot-spots, notably the Lake Victoria basin.
desc.stormsCyclone: Tropical cyclone and severe storm exposure on the coast and islands.
desc.volcano: Volcanic hazard near Ol Doinyo Lengai, Rungwe and Kilimanjaro/Meru.
desc.wildfire: Dry-season fire regime in miombo woodland.
desc.zoonoses: Animal and plant diseases and pests such as locust and armyworm.
desc.vehicleAccidents: Road-traffic accident exposure along highway corridors and cities.
desc.displacedPeople: Refugees, asylum seekers and internally displaced people.
desc.healthConditions: Burden of HIV, malaria and other diseases.
desc.childrenHealthNutrition: Under-five stunting, underweight and child mortality.
desc.economic: Economic vulnerability of specific groups (no sub-national data yet).
desc.accessHealth: Health facilities, staff and immunisation coverage.
desc.wash: Access to safe water and basic sanitation.
desc.communication: Roads, electricity, mobile phones and internet.
desc.drrImplementation: Disaster-risk-reduction plans, early warning and emergency operations capacity.
